title: Research Workflow Handoffs
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI for EE Research
description: A Mermaid flowchart of the five research workflow stages in the chapter's running SAR ADC example, with the handoff artifact on each arrow. Hovering a box shows its input, output, and handoff artifact in an info panel; clicking marks a box as visited, and clicking all seven boxes fires a confetti cannon.

accessibility.notes: Boxes are focusable buttons (Enter or Space marks the box as clicked; confetti fires after all seven are clicked, with a text progress counter); focus shows the same details as hover. Confetti is skipped when prefers-reduced-motion is set. Stage colors are never the only cue: every box carries its stage number and name.
